run_profiling_flux_eager: run torch.profiler profiling on the flux pipeline in eager mode
run_profiling_flux_compile: run torch.profiler profiling on the flux pipeline in torch.compile mode
run_benchmarking_flux: benchmark wall-clock inference time on the flux pipeline without profiler overhead
run_profiling_all_pipelines: run profiling on all supported diffusers pipelines in eager mode
build_pipeline_registry: build the pipeline config registry with flux, flux2, wan, ltx2, and qwenimage pipeline definitions
